id = "safety_study_1"

[[scenarios]]
id = "jet_fire_1"
name = "HP separator jet fire"
calculation = "process.jet_fire"

[scenarios.inputs]
distance = 20.0
heat_of_combustion = 50000000.0
mass_flow = 2.0
radiative_fraction = 0.2
target_flux = 12500.0

[[scenarios]]
id = "pool_fire_1"
name = "Diesel spill pool fire"
calculation = "process.pool_fire"

[scenarios.inputs]
burn_rate = 0.06
distance = 10.0
pool_diameter = 10.0

[[scenarios]]
id = "gaussian_plume_1"
name = "Urban plume at 500 m"
calculation = "process.gaussian_plume"

[scenarios.inputs]
crosswind = 0.0
distance = 500.0
effective_stack_height = 5.0
emission_rate = 1.0
height = 0.0
stability = "B"
terrain = "urban"
threshold = 0.0001
wind_speed = 3.0

[[scenarios]]
id = "deluge_1"
name = "High-velocity deluge on the deck"
calculation = "process.deluge_nozzle_layout"

[scenarios.inputs]
available_clearance = 1.2
coverage_efficiency = 1.0
nozzle_clearance = 1.0
nozzle_k = 42.9
nozzle_max_spacing = 3.0
nozzle_min_pressure = 3.5
operating_pressure = 5.0
protected_area = 510.0
required_density = 10.0

[[scenarios]]
id = "psv_1"
name = "Gas relief valve on the HP separator"
calculation = "process.psv_sizing"

[scenarios.inputs]
back_pressure = 101325.0
compressibility = 0.9
mass_flow = 1.0
molar_mass = 0.02
overpressure_fraction = 0.1
service = "gas"
set_pressure = 1000000.0
specific_heat_ratio = 1.3
temperature = 300.0

[[scenarios]]
id = "sif_1"
name = "HP separator overpressure SIF"
calculation = "process.safety_instrumented_function"

[scenarios.inputs]
base_availability = 0.99
claimed_sil = 2.0
lambda_du_per_hour = 0.000001
mttr_hours = 0.0
pfd_average = 0.005
spurious_trip_rate_per_year = 0.0
target_frequency_per_year = 0.00001
test_interval_hours = 8760.0
unmitigated_frequency_per_year = 0.1

[[bowties]]
id = "bt_separator_release"
name = "Separator loss of containment"
top_event = "Loss of containment from the HP separator"

[[bowties.threats]]
id = "th_corrosion"
label = "Corrosion under insulation"
frequency = 0.1
active = true

[[bowties.threats]]
id = "th_overpressure"
label = "Upstream overpressure"
frequency = 0.05
active = true

[[bowties.barriers]]
id = "pb_inspection"
label = "Inspection and corrosion monitoring"
pfd = 0.01
barrier_type = "prevention"
functional = true

[[bowties.barriers]]
id = "mb_emergency_response"
label = "Emergency response and muster"
pfd = 0.5
barrier_type = "mitigation"
functional = true

[[bowties.consequences]]
id = "co_jet_fire"
label = "Jet fire impinging on the separator"
severity = 5.0
scenario = "jet_fire_1"

[[bowties.consequences]]
id = "co_pool_fire"
label = "Pool fire in the bund"
severity = 4.0
scenario = "pool_fire_1"
